decision: Four read-only cloud slices, then one fix, then a confirmation swarm
why: The request covers code, behavior, performance, and UI. Four writers on one tree would collide, and a broad rewrite does not earn its place. Smallest proved change only.
The swarm workers line in pstack-models.mdc is missing, so the swarm skill default applies.

decision: Confirmation rule is rank all, N=3, identical brief
why: A win needs two passing checks that name the fix SHA and the method, and zero proved regressions. A result that omits the SHA or method does not count.
Each worker owns one slice and returns ranked candidates. They do not edit, so the later fix has one writer.
